title: Job offer comparison (comp, benefits, commute, culture)
description: Compare multiple job offers across compensation, benefits, commute, and culture to produce a weighted recommendation.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: job-offer-comparison
  title: Job offer comparison (comp, benefits, commute, culture)
  description: Compare multiple job offers across compensation, benefits, commute, and culture to produce a weighted recommendation.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Help the candidate decide between job offers using a consistent, weighted comparison of compensation, benefits, commute, and culture.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 3, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Offer details and priorities
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: "The offer letters or terms for each job, plus the candidate's priorities (e.g. weight given to pay, benefits, commute, culture)." }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: normalize
      kind: transform
      name: Normalize offer terms
      config: { operation: select, expression: "select base pay, bonus, equity, benefits, PTO, commute distance/time, and location fields from each offer" }
    - id: comp-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Total-compensation analyst
      role: Compensation analyst who evaluates the full economic value of a job offer.
      prompt: Compare the offers' base pay, bonus, equity, benefits, and PTO on a like-for-like basis. Note where offers use different structures (e.g. equity vesting schedules, signing bonuses) that make raw numbers misleading, and normalize accordingly.
      capabilities: { skills: [domain-analysis], tools: [read, calculate], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [comparison], properties: { comparison: { type: string }, notes: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
    - id: culture-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Culture and commute analyst
      role: Analyst who evaluates workplace culture, commute burden, and day-to-day fit.
      prompt: Compare the offers' stated work arrangement, commute distance or time, and any culture or team information provided. Flag anything unclear that the candidate should ask about before deciding.
      capabilities: { skills: [domain-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [comparison], properties: { comparison: { type: string }, notes: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
    - id: offer-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel offer analysis
      config: { members: [comp-analyst, culture-analyst], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: merge
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge offer analysis
      config: { aggregation: merge }
    - id: score
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Weighted decision score
      role: Independent evaluator who combines multiple analyses into a single weighted recommendation.
      prompt: Combine the compensation and culture/commute analyses using the candidate's stated priorities to compute a weighted score per offer. Return the scores, a recommended offer, and the reasons behind the ranking.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read, calculate], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.7 }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Offer comparison and recommendation
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: normalize, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: normalize, to: offer-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: offer-group, to: merge, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: merge, to: score, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: score, to: result, kind: data }
